verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV's Document report verifies the genuineness of identity documents. The Dashboard lets operators filter accepted documents by issuing country and document type, and NFC verification of ePassports is documented. This shows multi-country, multi-type document handling, but the evidence never enumerates supported countries or document types or points to a published coverage list. Missing for 10: a published supported countries/document-types list, explicit coverage of national IDs, driver licenses and residence permits, quantified country breadth, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published

citations.quote: A Document report verifies if an identity document uploaded by an applicant is genuine.
In your Dashboard, you can configure which documents you want to accept in your verification workflow, filtering according to issuing country and document type.
Entrust supports NFC data extraction from documents such as ePassports to verify document and biometric data as part of a Document report.
